x: Bob Taylor's track record for the mile would appear to be secure for a while, but we did see Blagrove of Ealing get inside Ian Marshall's 880 time.
John Thresher again beat 2 minutes in the 880 yds. taking 3rd place behind Blagrove.

These two battled throughout and soon disposed of Walton, Blackheath and Highgate but Ealing represented by Blagrove, Brighton with Briault, and Woodford with Chapman were making faster progress from behind and eventually passed our runner.
John Davies just failed to hold Blagrove of Ealing in the 2 miles and finished 10 yards down with 9:31.9.

John Thresher ran second to Blagrove in the 880 and on this track which he knows in every detail Blagrove seems almost unassailable. Gerry North also was up against a class athlete who has perfected the "Ealing technique" to a nicety, Mike Barratt.
